privacy: Generalized behavior and synthetic fixtures only. No private raw session text.

cases.input: A one-to-six-frame third shot appears between two intended cuts.
cases.expected: Detect it from source mapping, remove it unless a protected evidence-bound purpose exists, and review the repaired boundary at 0.25x.
cases.evidence: boundary audit, plus-or-minus-eight-frame strip, and supercut

cases.input: A sub-0.24-second segment below -40 dBFS remains at a cut.
cases.expected: Drop the residual handle and rerun the source-mapped boundary audit.
cases.evidence: energy measurement and repaired boundary manifest

cases.input: A delivered sentence ends before the source performance finishes.
cases.expected: Recover the complete source clause or remove the incomplete setup.
cases.evidence: source interval, delivered transcript, and ear review

cases.input: A system or Voice Mode response is omitted after its recorded prompt.
cases.expected: Restore only the declared original source interval; never synthesize a replacement.

cases.input: A project-locked caption correction is misspelled or a future word is visible.
cases.expected: Apply the exact override and prove progressive delivered timing.
cases.evidence: caption override binding and onset frames

cases.input: Critical screen information or the speaker is cropped.
cases.expected: Restore readable context and a non-clipped face without hiding proof.

cases.input: Motion is basic, text-heavy, late, or visually disconnected from speech.
cases.expected: Use refined seek-safe illustration synchronized to the spoken beat, with sparse text.

cases.input: A synthetic fixture binds byte_count=247, but the rendered number shows another value.
cases.expected: Block until the rendered fact matches its hash-bound source.

cases.input: A synthetic caption fixture requires tile to be corrected to dial, but the delivered caption still says tile.
cases.expected: Block until the exact project override is visible at the correct delivered onset.
cases.evidence: caption override binding and onset frames

cases.input: Music is not authentic lo-fi or masks speech.
cases.expected: Use provenance-bound suitable music at a restrained speech-safe level.
cases.evidence: cue provenance, loudness measurement, and ear review

cases.input: One generic pass JSON is reused for unrelated gates.
cases.expected: Reject every mismatched gate; require the declared evaluator and gate-specific manifest.

cases.input: The editor labels every detected boundary candidate designed and declares 100.
cases.expected: Reject promotion until deterministic candidate decisions and independent review prove the final timeline clean.
